summary.headline: Astrological Judgment of Letters
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging letters by the horoscope: Saturn, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and the Moon at the horoscope, midheaven, setting of the Sun, or in stationary condition signify hostility, plots, deceit, destruction, or favorable news and trustworthy writers. The text also describes the character and status of letter-writers, carriers, and recipients, with Jupiter or Venus modifying Saturn, Mars, and Mercury indications.
